about: Every surface that connects a backend artifact to a published page (JEG-424). Read by modules/status.html (live, in the browser) and tests/test_published_surfaces.py (at build time, inside make validate). url is relative to the site root.

surfaces.label: Comparison sources (chart values)
surfaces.meaning: parses, at least 5 sources, fixture built within 8 days

surfaces.label: Reference freshness
surfaces.meaning: parses, at least one item, generated within 24h; degraded while any input is past its window (GAP-033)

surfaces.label: Consolidated values export
surfaces.backend: make sync (build_consolidated_values reconciliation) from the validated fixture
surfaces.meaning: parses, at least 1,000 rows, built within 8 days

surfaces.label: Source import health
surfaces.meaning: parses, all 7 sources present, checked within 12h (twice the 6h health-artifacts cadence; monitoring-summary producer.stale_after_minutes)

surfaces.label: Pipeline checkpoints
surfaces.meaning: parses, checkpoints present, generated within 12h (twice the 6h health-artifacts cadence; monitoring-summary producer.stale_after_minutes)

surfaces.label: Is everything working? (Supabase check observations)
surfaces.meaning: parses and was snapshotted within 12h (twice the 6h health-artifacts cadence; monitoring-summary producer.stale_after_minutes); the file is red on its own when Supabase could not be read (the banner, not this row, carries pass/fail)

surfaces.label: Ops status (deploys, synthetic check, alerts, identity queue, bake)
surfaces.meaning: parses, all 5 blocks present, generated within 7h (each block also carries its own as_of and error)

surfaces.label: Comparison chain status
surfaces.meaning: parses, a chain run recorded within 7h

surfaces.label: GitHub Actions status
surfaces.meaning: parses, workflows listed, generated within 7h

surfaces.label: 8-group totals
surfaces.meaning: parses, all 8 groups, source leg within 8 days

surfaces.label: Player trace
surfaces.meaning: parses, players present, generated within 13h

surfaces.label: Data fidelity pulse (publisher -> stored -> live chart)
surfaces.backend: fidelity-pulse.yml (pg_cron every 3h + after each rebuild chain run)
surfaces.meaning: parses, all four trade charts present, checked within 7h (twice the 3h cadence plus one)

surfaces.label: Source fidelity
surfaces.meaning: parses, generated within 8 days

surfaces.label: Index math
surfaces.meaning: parses, generated within 8 days

surfaces.label: Scale agreement
surfaces.meaning: parses, generated within 8 days

surfaces.label: Cross-source agreement
surfaces.meaning: parses, generated within 8 days

surfaces.label: Chart input coverage
surfaces.meaning: parses, generated within 8 days

surfaces.label: End-to-end fidelity (JEG-77 card)
surfaces.meaning: parses, all 4 published sources, generated within 36h (deploys run daily and after every chain push)

surfaces.label: Data accuracy (ESPN-zeroed staleness)
surfaces.meaning: parses, both checks present, generated within 36h (deploys run daily and after every chain push)

surfaces.label: Input lineage (derived sections vs their inputs)
surfaces.meaning: generated within 8h by the chain (scheduled every 6h, more often when a source changes); degraded while any derived section's lineage disagrees with its current input (GAP-044)
